_note: School of Sport container context pack for criticality-intermediate. The subject is the School of Sport as a whole (sport & exercise science, sport coaching and physical education, sport management and development, sport therapy and rehabilitation, strength & conditioning), not a single discipline. There is no QAA benchmark for sport in this repo, so the prose is grounded in sport & exercise science / sport domain knowledge. Worked examples vary the sport subject across lessons: L01 sport & exercise science, L02 sport coaching, L03 sport management and development.
